detail.longDescription: Hello Mastodon! 👋 Thought I'd introduce myself! I'm Mike, living in North Yorkshire, UK. By day I'm a Church of England vicar, but this account is mostly for indulging my geeky side! I'm a Linux enthusiast, running an OMV home server with Docker, Nextcloud, Home Assistant, Immich and various other bits and pieces. I've recently moved to a Jolla phone running Sailfish OS, and I'm enjoying exploring life beyond Android and Google. I'm interested in open source, self-hosting, privacy and digital independence. I enjoy tinkering, learning new things and occasionally breaking stuff before figuring out how to fix it! # Introduction # Introductions # Linux # SelfHosting # OpenSource # SailfishOS # Jolla # OpenMediaVault # Docker # HomeAssistant # Nextcloud # DeGoogle # Fediverse
